test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT true regarding GST?

options.text: France is the first country to introduce GST.
July 1st is celebrated as GST day by the Central Board of Excise and Customs.
GST cannot be collected by the state government.
India has chosen Canada’s structure of dual GST.

solution:
The correct answer is__** ​GST cannot be collected by the state government.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__****Goods and Services Tax(GST)**

__
 
• Indirect tax used in India on the** supply of goods and services.**
 
• **comprehensive, multistage, destination-based tax.**
 
• Goods and services are divided into** five different tax slabs for collection of tax: 0%, 5%, 12%, 18% and 28%.**
 
• The tax came into effect from** 1 July 2017.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Petroleum products, alcoholic drinks, and electricity **are not taxed under GST and instead are taxed separately by the individual** state governments.**
 
• With the implementation of the** One Hundred and First Amendment of the Constitution of India by the Indian government. **
 
• The **GST replaced existing multiple taxes levied by the central and state governments.**
